ios.desc:
BettorEdge is the social betting marketplace. You bet against real people, not the house, so the price comes from bettors instead of a sportsbook protecting its margin.

Challenge a friend, run a pool for your group, or take the best price on the board. It all happens in one app.

BET PEOPLE, NOT THE HOUSE
Every bet is matched with another bettor. See the full order book for every game, with the dollars waiting at each price, and take the best one on the board.

NAME YOUR PRICE
Take the best price right now with a market order, or set your own price with a limit order and wait for someone to take it.

CHALLENGE A FRIEND
Send a head-to-head challenge to one person. Only they can accept it, and BettorEdge keeps your running record against them, game by game.

SETTLE IT IN THE CHAT
Start a group, invite your crew, and see what everyone is on right next to the conversation. Follow other bettors and see when they are in a game.

RUN YOUR OWN CONTEST
Create pick'ems, brackets, squares, silent auction squares, calcuttas and wager competitions (parlays allowed) for your league, office or friends.

TRACK EVERY POSITION
Your portfolio shows what you have at stake, what you stand to win, your working orders and the live value of every position.

SPORTS
NFL, college football, MLB, WNBA and more, with spreads, moneylines and totals.

WHY BETTORS SWITCH
• 35,000+ bettors
• $100M+ matched between bettors
• Legal in 45+ states
• $10 free when you verify your ID, no deposit needed
• BE 4 Good, our give-back mission

Questions? Email support@bettoredge.com.
